notes.title: Summer Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,



a preliminary update for the Windows version (V6.5) is posted to Steam, fixing a slew of issues that people have reported:

No more infinite loop at the end of the game

Tunnels are now integrated into the sound settings

Mouse should be less weird when Alt-Tab-ing

re-encoding of all videos

move to Unity 6 renderer

Versions for the other operating systems will follow soon.

Thanks so much for all the feedback! We still have another Updated coming in the fall - with a demo and some story tie-in for our next game, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Award Nomination and Glitch Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators.

we are ✨incredibly✨ excited to be nominated for "Best Story" for this year's Deutscher Computerspielepreis (German Videogames Award): 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182888/fecdc2f9c24fa76b9723d570e94eafffe8116a7d.png

Since this is our first game, and it's all funded with our own money, this is obviously huge for us.

But there's more good news! One of the few thoughtfully worded complaints from the reviews mentions a certain amount of frustration building up over the course of finishing the game.
Today's update is hopefully addressing some of those concerns by removing the complete restart of longer glitch courses when the ball falls out of bounds. Instead, you can now continue from the last blocker you hit. 
This change is valid for all difficulty levels from Version 6.0.

Thank you so much to everyone who has reached out via our Discord, on our socials or by writing your thoughts here on Steam on the forums or as a review. It means the world to us.

And we have still more exciting new things in store for you these coming weeks!
Take care!

notes.title: Spring Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

after much rewiring under the hood, we are happy to finally bring you full Gamepad Support for Version 5.0!
Stay tuned in the coming weeks as we have a number of super exciting announcements to make!

Thanks, as always, to our Discord and Steam community for all Feedback and thoughts!

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

we're excited to bring you the first major feature update of the year - playstyle customization in the form of three difficulty adjustments:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182888/a0b40d197d5463672f98ef675250a487b45eb401.gif

They don't fundamentally change the game, but they allow the game to cater to a more varied mix of playstyles - those that are mainly interested in the story, those that like to add deducing hints from separate media, and those that enjoy a bit more of a mini-golfing challenge on top.
It's possible to change your preference anytime during your playthrough.

As always, our Discord and Steam Discussion boards are open for your Input and we are eager to adjust things along the way.

Stay tuned, there will be more! We have some exciting things coming from the studio throughout this year, all tied in to Mini Mini Golf Golf.

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

thanks to your Feedback, we were able to identify a number of small and enormous (when it came to some of the subtitles on the Mini Mini Talk Talk episodes) text based kerfuffles and are happy to report that they are all fixed now.

* fixed subtitles in MiniMiniTalkTalk episode 3
* fixed subtitles in MiniMiniTalkTalk episode 6
* fixed typo in "Breakup"
* fixed PDA not showing final segment 
* fixed rare edge case of ball getting stuck on course boundary when jumping out of hole again.

Plus: A workaround for those affected by Steam Deck Issues:
If you installed the game on Steam Deck prior to the 3.2. patch, a typo in the Steam Cloud configuration has led to a catastrophic problem with save game folder file names. 
Fortunately, things can be fixed by deleting the game's save game folder from Home/.config/unity3d/ThreeMoreYears (just remove that ThreeMoreYears folder), or just renaming the folder within from MIniMiniGolfGolf to MiniMiniGolfGolf.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this typo!

Thanks again to everyone who took some time out of their day to report a bug or two.
Happy resonating!

notes.title: New Year's Patch
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

here's a small Patch to fix some major issues that were still present in the game.

✨ Patch to Version 3.23 ✨

 fixed Issues with Steam Deck not starting (!)
 fixed issues where Game was not startable when finishing intro without skipping (!)
 happy new year! And thanks for everyone's feedback!
 


Enjoy and Happy 2025!

notes.title: Post Release Update 3
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

we're happy to bring you the last update for this year:

✨Update to Version 3.2✨

 Hack Course now appears after first time repeating Training with Glitch
 fixed Hack Button not removed if returning to Minigolf Main Menu
 Text-Log now appears in every glitched course
 blocker disappear a little snappier on lower framerates
 unlocks now display correct date
 signal screen now switches to appropriate episode of Mini Mini Talk Talk when in a hub section
 any key now skips intro (and outro if watched for second time)


This will be the last content and gameplay update this year, game - breaking bugs notwithstanding - and we'll be back with more updates in the new year!
Enjoy the holidays to those that celebrate!

notes.title: 3.1x Patch Released
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

this patch contains the following fixes:

* fixes unlockable videos not playing
* fixes some video playback issues
* fixed unlockable videos from tunnel menu playing fullscreen without the possibility to stop
* fixed potential crash after playing videos from tunnel menu
* fixed Linux Version

macOS patch is coming a little later. 
Thanks again for all your feedback!

notes.title: Post Release Update 2
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators,

we have made another post-release adjustment from your Feedback:

Zoe will now help you with unlocking resonant tunnels if you are struggling.
If you tried for more than three rounds but didn't get the unlock, she will spawn a button to hack the glitch through code.

We hope this takes away Frustration and leads to a more smooth gameplay experience.

Along with this update come some fixes:
* no longer getting stuck between the Screens and the PDA, 
* cleaned up some illegible text 
* moved Videos out of Addressables for (hopefully) faster playback

new Version number is now 3.0

Again, thank you for your Feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Post-Release Update 1
notes.notes:
✨ Update to Version 2.8 ✨ 


 added log Text to courses in which text frequently overlaps, to make the lines more readable
 tweaked ball movement in poetry courses (now stops much quicker)
 disabled interactivity when minigolf course is being glitched


Again, thank you all so much for your feedback and support!
PC Version is online now, MacOS and Linux will follow within the next hour or so.

notes.title: Patch 2.771
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators!

thank you so much to those of you who have reported Bugs and Feedback on our official Forums and Discord.

fixed:
* a bug in which early progress does not get saved
* a fallback for background not showing on game start
* a stopping bug that does not allow progress beyond initial signals

WIndows Version is up to date, Mac and Linux Versions are to follow today.
There are still some issues reported that we will investigate:

* A bug in "Decision" unlock
* Fails to start on Steam Deck.

We are working on fixes for the latter, yet proper SteamDeck support will probably come at a later stage.
Thank you so much for your support so far!

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Fellow Resonators!

[previewyoutube=-lM485mcCiw;full][/previewyoutube]

First of all, thank you all so much for showing up at Next Level Festival and Games Ground these past couple of days. So many of you played our game and we got so much positive feedback, it really warms our hearts!

We want to make sure that you all are getting an experience that is worthy of your appreciation so far - and for that we want to take a little longer to work on our game.

So we have decided to push our release date to 12.12.24.

We are so excited to get the full game into your hands as soon as possible, and we feel these extra weeks will give us the opportunity to be less stressed and more coordinated in our launch, resulting in a better experience for you, our players.

We have many things we want to talk to you about in these coming weeks, so stay tuned for more updates.

Three More Years Team

notes.title: Release Date 28. Nov. 2024
notes.notes:
Release Date Announced! Last Weekend of Demo!

Fellow Resonators, 
we are pleased to announce that Mini Mini Golf Golf will release on 
28 Nov 2024
for PC, Mac, SteamDeck and Linux!

Here's a little reveal Video we made:
[previewyoutube=8Caqj0qjJU8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are incredibly excited, and a little anxious.

Also, a heads up! We know that Next Fest was a great opportunity to check out way too many demos, and we happily left our demo up for a while to give everyone a chance to sample the game. 
That said, we will take down the demo this Sunday, 3rd Nov, to focus our efforts on the main release.

Until next time!

notes.title: Next Fest Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Akonia tech section, fellow Resonators! 

Our first Next Fest Update is here, and it greatly reduces loading-times!

This is made possible through a change in the data structuring of our build. 
So unfortunately, that means that large parts of the Demo will be redownloaded for this update to work.
We believe that faster loading will greatly benefit the playing experience though.

Stay tuned for more updates as we make our way through Next Fest!

As always, let us know in the Discord if you encounter anything extraordinary!
